slides.heading: Right Smaller Than
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Very Hard · Binary Search Trees
slides.narration: Let's solve Right Smaller Than, a very hard binary search trees problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: For each element, how many elements to its right are strictly smaller?
Insert from the right into an augmented BST tracking left-subtree sizes.
slides.narration: Here's the problem. For each element, how many elements to its right are strictly smaller? Insert from the right into an augmented BST tracking left-subtree sizes.

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: Insert from the right into a BST that knows its left-subtree sizes; each insert counts the smaller values already there.

bullets: 3. Add left sizes when going right
